number_domain: safe integers only; reject -0, fractions, exponents, NaN, Infinity
arrays: x-order=set sorts x-sort-keys lexicographically by UTF-16 strings or canonical item bytes; duplicate keys/items rejected; x-order=ordered preserves input
nullable: all content fields required; explicit null where schema permits; omitted optional API fields map to their declared default before Content construction
references: direct immutable reference bindings in each envelope; verify transitive closure for export; never include own digest
